Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned by the issuer to the undertaking, for example the guarantee or standby number.

SequenceNumber.name: Sequence Number
SequenceNumber.definition: Sequence number assigned by the issuer to each amendment of the undertaking.

BeneficiaryReferenceNumber.name: Beneficiary Reference Number
BeneficiaryReferenceNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned by the beneficiary to the undertaking.
